snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Geralt returns to the Path in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past.

This full-fledged third expansion takes the White Wolf on a new adventure to the peaceful realm of Letten, where dark secrets lurk beneath the surface… Coming in 2027 to GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, Battle.net, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Wishlist now! https://www.thewitcher.com/buy
